08:30 Local Time, 02:30 GMT, 08:00 IST: Hello and a warm welcome to our live coverage of the opening day of the second Test between Bangladesh and West Indies in Sylhet. The visitors were brilliant with the ball in the first Test in Dhaka with their spinners outbowling their counterparts. Warrican stole the limelight with a 9-wicket haul in the game while Chase broke the backbone of the opposition with his 5-fer in the second innings. Even after conceding a slender 27-run first innings lead, the visitors bowled out the hosts for a paltry 142 and chased it down with consummate ease with Brandon King paving the way with 81*. While spin played a significant part in Dhaka, expect the Sylhet surface to be conducive for the pacers. There will be more pace and bounce on this surface so the ball will also come nicely to the bat.

The West Indies have been impressive this year in Tests (haven't lost a series) and will be eyeing to shine through in Sylhet to cap off a good year. They drew against Pakistan and Sri Lanka at home - if they manage to win away from home, it will be a big achievement for them. Bangladesh, meanwhile, registered a famous Test win against Australia in Darwin in August but their inconsistency in the longest format will be a concern. Mushfiqur Rahim will probably slot into their XI after missing out in the last game as he has recovered from a finger injury. Amite Hasan has been recalled into the squad after Mominul was concussed in the first Test.
West Indies have won the toss and have opted to bat
